name: vshulcz/deja-vu
title: vshulcz/deja-vu
headline: deja-vu shares one memory across coding agents
lede: You can search and reuse fixes from past sessions across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI and others, using history already on disk.

effects.effect: Reduces repeated debugging across different agents
Makes session history a shared asset across agent tools

appearances.title: vshulcz/deja-vu
appearances.summary: Coding agent memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 39 more, built from the session history already on your disk. Local search, MCP and hooks, no LLM, one Go binary.

appearances.title: vshulcz/deja-vu
appearances.summary: One memory shared by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw and 30 more coding agents, built from the session history already on disk. A fix found in one agent comes back in any of them, including months of sessions from before you installed it. No LLM, no embeddings, one local Go binary.
